photos.name: loaf-crumb
photos.summary: Cross-section of whole wheat sourdough held in hand — moderately open crumb with even small-to-medium bubbles and a few larger holes near the top. Golden-brown crust, banneton ring pattern visible on the uncut half behind. Kitchen scale and banneton in background.

photos.name: loaf-exterior
photos.summary: Whole wheat sourdough boule on copper wire cooling rack — deep golden crust with heavy flour dusting and banneton spiral pattern. Single score visible with modest ear. Held at angle showing profile and bottom crust color.
